records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Harbor Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *Harbor Dynamics* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14 with zero product progress: no project, no invite, no key milestone. Two Wrenfield touches (email:c3bbff22, email:bf2a5b22) went unanswered, and no tickets or any customer communication at all, so no signal of intent. Silent, unengaged Starter accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting Harbor Dynamics started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on my welcome note from last week. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating one around a piece of real work is the quickest way to see whether it fits how Harbor Dynamics runs.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you get that first project set up with you. Just reply with a couple of times that work and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Chidi
